generalCriterionList.description: Tenders  from Joint ventures are not acceptable.

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka
Bidders shall ensure upload of relevant document certifying his/her status as Scheduled Caste/ Scheduled Tribe/other reserved category as prescribed in the tender document.

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
Bidders are requested to go through the Bid documents

technicalCriterionList.description: Total value of civl engineering works executed and payments received in the last five years (year-wise)
List of existing commitments and ongoing work
List of works for which tenders already submitted

The bidder shall be a regular Contractor/Agency/Firm and shall have proven experience in carrying out LMV or HGV or Material Handling vehicle repair/body works and hould have satisfactorily completed similar works worth Rs.4.96 Lakhs in single work order in any one of the preceding five financial years (2021-22, 2022-23, 2023-24,2024-25 & 2025-26)As a proof of this the bidder shall upload Single Work order and corresponding Work done / Work completion certificate. Work done of previous years shall be given weight of 10% per year to bring them to the present price level of the financial year in which the tenders are invited.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- As a proof of this, the bidder should upload a single work order and corresponding Work Done Certificate issued by competent authority

technicalCriterionList.description: The bidder in his name should have achieved an average annual financial turnover of Rs. 9.92 Lakhs in at least two financial years during the last Five Years. (2021-22, 2022-23, 2023-24, 2024-25 & 2025-26). As a proof of this, the bidder shall upload the certified copy of Profit & Loss Account Statements or Turn over Certificates duly certified by a Chartered Accountant. Financial turnover of previous years shall be given weight of 10% per year to bring them to the present price level of the financial year in which the tenders are invited

tenderSubEstimateList.subEstimateName: Repair works of various type of Departmental Vehicles and Equipment including 22-Ton Crane, Bolero Jeep, Fire Vehicles, Bolero Pickup Vans, Engine Major Repairs, Mechanical, Electrical, Denting, Painting, Hood & Canvas, Wire Rope, Oil Seal Replacement, and Driver/Co-driver Seat Repair Works

itemList.description: Engine Maintenance Work, including Fuel System Servicing, Nozzle and Fuel Pump Servicing, Cylinder Head Servicing, Engine Oil Change, Replacement of Oil and Diesel Filters, and Other Related Works as per the Detailed Scope for Vehicles No. KA36N2051 and KA36M9464
Electrical Works, including Replacement of All Worn-Out Wiring Kits, Headlights, Indicators, Wiper Motors, and Wiper Blades for Vehicles No. KA36N20251, KA36B8536, KA36A8537 and KA36M9464.

Complete Body Denting Works, including Replacement/Repair of Front and Rear Bumpers, Windshield, Right and Left Door Panels, and Side Mirrors on Both Sides (Right and Left) Painting Works, including Application of Two Coats of the Existing Colour for Vehicle No. KA36N2051.

Servicing/Repair of the Brake System, Suspension System, Steering System Works and Clutch System, with Replacement of the Pressure Plate, Clutch Plate, Radiator Cooling tank, PT Gear box throttle set and Other Allied Works, as per the Detailed Scope for Vehicle No.KA36A8536, KA36B8537 & KA36C4621
Hood and Canvas Works, including Replacement of Driver and Co-Driver Seats for Pickup Vans KA36A3434, KA36C6343, and KA36C6344

Replacement of Jack Seals, Reconditioning of the Piston Rod for the Lifting Ram, Replacement of Lifting Ram Oil Seals, O-Rings, Replacement of 20 mm Wire Rope, and Other Related Works, Including Denting and Painting of the Main Frame (KA36/M9464).
